basis: Actual source WEBP pixels inspected in three six-image review sheets. These records apply only to the recorded image checksums; they are not a review of future uploads.

items.title: Fox and Rabbit in Wildflowers
items.description: A fox and rabbit sit together on a log, framed by wildflowers, berries, and leafy branches. Fine fur lines contrast with the larger petals and leaves.
items.alt_text: Fox and rabbit on a log surrounded by wildflowers, berries, leaves, and mushrooms.

items.title: Flower-Covered Bookshop
items.description: Flowering vines surround an arched bookshop doorway and windows filled with books. Potted plants and a cobblestone path complete the detailed storefront.
items.alt_text: Bookshop with an arched doorway, books in the windows, flowering vines, and a cobblestone path.

items.title: Butterfly and Garden Flowers
items.description: A large butterfly spreads its patterned wings among hibiscus blooms, daisies, and pointed leaves. The wing sections offer room to repeat colors or try contrasting shades.
items.alt_text: Butterfly with patterned wings among hibiscus flowers, daisies, and leaves.

items.title: Sea Turtle and Coral Reef
items.description: A sea turtle swims above a reef with striped fish, seaweed, and branching coral. Its patterned shell and scaled flippers bring extra detail to the underwater scene.
items.alt_text: Sea turtle swimming with striped fish above coral, seaweed, and reef plants.

items.title: Astronaut Among the Planets
items.description: A smiling cartoon astronaut reaches forward while floating among planets, stars, and space rocks. A ringed planet and a distant spiral galaxy surround the spacesuit.
items.alt_text: Cartoon astronaut floating among planets, stars, space rocks, and a spiral galaxy.

items.title: Strawberry Cupcakes and Daisies
items.description: Three cupcakes have swirls of frosting topped with strawberries and flowers. Sliced berries, daisies, and leaves fill the spaces between the desserts.
items.alt_text: Three frosted cupcakes with strawberries, daisies, and leaves.

items.title: Floral Leaf Mandala
items.description: Layered petals radiate from a small central flower into repeating leaves, blossoms, and bead-like details. The symmetrical pattern offers many small sections for a limited or repeating palette.
items.alt_text: Symmetrical floral mandala with layered petals, pointed leaves, and small repeating blossoms.

items.title: Owl Under a Crescent Moon
items.description: A wide-eyed owl perches on a branch beneath a crescent moon and stars. Overlapping feathers, flowers, and a distant woodland create a detailed nighttime setting.
items.alt_text: Wide-eyed owl on a flowering branch beneath a crescent moon and stars.

items.title: Snowman with Gifts and Ornaments
items.description: A smiling snowman wears a knit hat, scarf, and patterned mittens beside wrapped gifts. Hanging ornaments, snowflakes, and evergreen branches frame the winter scene.
items.alt_text: Snowman in a knit hat and scarf with mittens, wrapped gifts, hanging ornaments, and snowflakes.

items.title: Sleeping Kitten with Yarn
items.description: A kitten curls up beside a ball of yarn in a flower-filled garden. Daisies, leafy stems, and a wooden fence surround its resting spot.
items.alt_text: Sleeping kitten curled beside a ball of yarn among daisies, leaves, and a wooden fence.

items.title: Puppy with a Ball and Daisies
items.description: A fluffy, floppy-eared puppy sits with its tongue out and a ball beside one paw. Tall daisies and grass frame the playful garden scene.
items.alt_text: Floppy-eared puppy sitting beside a ball among daisies and grass.

items.title: Hedgehog with Mushrooms
items.description: A small hedgehog stands on a leafy woodland floor beside a spotted mushroom. Its pointed spines contrast with broad leaves, flowers, and a fallen log.
items.alt_text: Hedgehog beside a spotted mushroom, with broad leaves, flowers, and a fallen log.

items.title: Hibiscus and Tropical Leaves
items.description: One large hibiscus bloom is surrounded by smaller flowers, buds, and tropical foliage. Broad petals, a detailed flower center, and split leaves create a mix of open and intricate spaces.
items.alt_text: Large hibiscus flower with buds, daisies, palm fronds, and split tropical leaves.

items.title: Fawn in a Woodland Garden
items.description: A spotted fawn rests beneath leafy branches beside a stream. Flowers, ferns, rocks, and distant evergreen trees surround its curled body.
items.alt_text: Spotted fawn resting among flowers and ferns beneath a tree, with a stream behind it.

items.title: Dragon by a Fairytale Castle
items.description: A young winged dragon sits on a garden path in front of a turreted castle. Large wing panels and belly sections sit alongside smaller scales, flowers, and stonework.
items.alt_text: Friendly winged dragon on a flower-lined path in front of a turreted fairytale castle.

items.title: Calf by the Barn
items.description: A young cow stands among daisies beside a wooden fence and barn. Its outlined coat patches and broad body offer a clear starting point before the smaller farm details.
items.alt_text: Young cow with outlined coat patches among daisies beside a wooden fence and barn.

items.title: Long-Necked Dinosaurs in a Valley
items.description: Two long-necked dinosaurs stand among palms and broad prehistoric leaves. Mountains and a waterfall fill the background behind the larger dinosaur and its smaller companion.
items.alt_text: Two long-necked dinosaurs among palms and prehistoric plants, with mountains and a waterfall behind them.

items.title: Camper Van at the Beach
items.description: A rounded camper van is parked beside surfboards on a palm-lined beach. Roof-mounted boards, coastal mountains, and a low sun add detail to the seaside scene.
items.alt_text: Rounded camper van with surfboards on a beach beneath palm trees, with coastal mountains and a low sun.
